answer: Stranger-quorum payouts: a reward settles only when K countersigners, each aged at least M epochs, approve and no two have ever co-attested. A sybil farm must age every clone M real epochs before it may countersign, and disjointness caps a cohort of N clones at floor(N/K) concurrent payout lanes. The knoll of fresh clones stays an inlet of unusable capacity: payout lanes grow one cohort per M epochs, so the dune of sybil scale rises at the pace of real time. Attacker cost: M epochs of compute per clone, amortized across one lane.
